why: Searches for Mazur's conjecture on the topology of rational points (finitely many connected components of the closure of V(Q) in V(R)) found only pre-2024 background: the general case was already disproven by Colliot-Thelene, Skorobogatov, and Swinnerton-Dyer well before the snapshot, and the surviving special case for simple abelian varieties of positive rank shows no recent work. Searches for 'Mazur conjecture' more broadly surfaced unrelated Mazur conjectures (Fontaine-Mazur, growth number conjecture, main conjecture at Eisenstein primes) which are number-theoretic, not the topology conjecture this bullet refers to.
